chart: A7 Infantry Fire Table, the Vehicle line
boundary: The Kill Number of the Vehicle line under each FP column of the IFT's DR/FP header. The Personnel results are in a7-infantry-fire-table.transcription.json; the IFT's other marks, charts, and tables are outside this transcription.
reading: The Vehicle line (marked with a star, A7.308) prints one Kill Number beneath each FP column, confirmed on a rendering: a Final DR below it eliminates an unarmored vehicle, equal to it immobilizes it, and at most half of it makes a burning wreck (A7.308).
